# Gordon & MacPhail (distilled at Rosebank) 1989 Vintage, 10 year old, 40%

[Buy Now](https://whiskyadvocate.com/Gordon-MacPhail-distilled-at-Rosebank-1989-Vintage-10-year-old-40)
